assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is indicated
The monitoring is to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other significant arrhythmias
The service is necessary to correlate symptoms with potential rhythm disturbances over an extended period
